name: truck-talk-android
description: Native Android wrapper for the Truck Talk English course app

scripts.copy-web: mkdir -p www/icons www/shared && cp ../index.html ../app.js ../curriculum.js ../grammar.js ../manifest.json ../sw.js www/ && cp ../icons/*.png www/icons/ && cp ../shared/*.js ../shared/*.css www/shared/
scripts.sync: npm run copy-web && cap sync android
